name: Motorcycle Simulator Germany
summary:
Ride the German Autobahn from the seat - alone or with your friends.

46 KM OF REAL FRANKFURT AUTOBAHN
The A5 north past the Westkreuz and the Nordwestkreuz, the A661 south past the Frankfurt skyline and over the Main, the A3 west through the Stadtwald past the Waldstadion. Three real Autobahn interchanges.

NO SPEED LIMIT
About 20 km of the ring is unrestricted. When the end-of-limits sign comes up, tuck in and hold it flat out. Real German signs all the way round.
